note: What a server sends to set a unit moving along a path at a speed of its own, perhaps in an arc or following another unit. The header names the unit. A client answers every one at once, before checking its sync id, as it answers Path. It applies it only where the sync id is not older than the last the unit took (as UnitStopped).

fields.name: gravity
fields.note: The arc's gravity, for a leap.

fields.name: facing
fields.note: Which way the unit faces as it moves.

fields.name: follow
fields.note: A unit to follow, or zero for none.

fields.name: followDistance
fields.note: How near to keep to it. Read where follow is not zero.

fields.name: backOff
fields.note: How far to fall back from it. Read where follow is not zero.

fields.name: travelTime
fields.note: How long the move takes. Read where follow is not zero.

fields.name: points
fields.note: The path's points, to the end of the message. A client takes the ground's height for each.
